//@version=6
indicator("UCTPROBE_VW_BI_PIVOT_POINT_LEVELS_B", overlay = true)

// U-BUILTIN (2026-11-19). WHAT `ta.pivot_point_levels(type, anchor, developing)` RETURNS, LEVEL BY LEVEL.
//
// The reference names the eleven levels [P, R1, S1, R2, S2, R3, S3, R4, S4, R5, S5] and the six types and
// gives no formula for any of them, nor the value on the bars before the first anchor.
// committed:previous-day-high-and-low-separators-dailyweekly calls
// `ta.pivot_point_levels("Traditional", timeframe.change(tfAuto))`. This half reads Classic, DM, Camarilla on a weekly
// anchor, developing = false. P is plotted per type; a level the type does not compute reads na.
//
// CAPTURE: AMEX:SPY 1D from the listing and NYSE:RDDT 1D from the listing. Inputs at defaults.

anchor = timeframe.change("W")
plot(bar_index, "P0_bar_index_CONTROL")
lv1 = ta.pivot_point_levels("Classic", anchor)
plot(array.get(lv1, 0), "Classic_0")
plot(array.get(lv1, 1), "Classic_1")
